title: Sententious
summary: SENTEN'TIOUS, adjective 1. Abounding with sentences, axioms and maxims; short and energetic; as a sententious style or discourse; sententious truth. How he apes his sire, Ambitiously sententious. Addi

inlines.v: SENTEN'TIOUS, adjective 1. Abounding with sentences, axioms and maxims; short and energetic; as a sententious style or discourse; sententious truth. How he apes his sire, Ambitiously sententious. Addison. 2. Comprising sentences; as sententious marks. [This should be sentential.]
